title: Barney Bigard's start on tenor and clarinet; Albert Nicholas in Oliver's band
summary: Barbarin says Bigard began on tenor, took up clarinet at Tom Anderson's, and that Albert Nicholas was Oliver's featured clarinetist.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: I know what I wanted to ask you. What about Barney when he was down here? What did he play? What instrument was that?
When he first started? He played the tenor. He first started on tenor.
When did he take up the clarinet?

Well, he took the clarinet while we were working at Tom Anderson. He and Albert Nicholas team were together. He played like a flute at that time. He used to call him Snake Chalmers. He used to call him. He used to kill him all the time. Albert Nicholas used to laugh at him all the time. So I told him, don't pay attention about laughing at him. Just continue trying to play his horn. Keep on practicing. Well, that guy came up very fast. When he was in King Oliver's band, he started featuring the clarinet. He started featuring him on the clarinet and from then on he went on.
Did he ever play clarinet at all with Oliver?

Yeah, yeah. He played clarinet with Oliver. I mean, in the section, you know, Barney and Albert Nicholas and Darnell Howard, you know. Yeah. But Albert was the best clarinet player, I mean, at that time, at that particular time.
Well, so did Oliver feature on clarinet mostly?
Who did he feature on clarinet when he had Begad?
Oh, well, he featured Albert. Albert was the main clarinet player.
Of course, there's Simeon on these two. Yeah. Begad was mostly a tenor player. Yeah.
